response.overview: A trilogy story from the serialized adaptations Eternal Love (Ombak Rindu 2) and My Longing for Love (Ombak Rindu 3), which revolves around the journey of Hariz and Izzah navigating the thorns and pitfalls of love after a dark secret resurfacesonce again. The strong bond between Hariz and Izzah unravels when misunderstandings turn into conflict. Pak Mok, Hariz's personal guide who orchestrated everything, has successfully abducted Izzah.
response.title: Ombak Rindu The Series
